Container.Name: qwen38-flash-next-gufo
Container.Overview: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B MoE, 6B active) served by Gufo on AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151) via ROCm 10.0. [br]Gufo is the purpose-built Flash-Next server from the kyuz0 toolbox: MTP speculative decoding with a 7-token draft window, 133K context in one session, and an OpenAI-compatible API on :8080. Weights are the UD-Q4_K_XL 4-shard set plus the shared Q8_0 MTP head; start.sh downloads them on first boot if the models share is empty (aria2, resumable, SHA-256 checked). [br]Runtime config lives in /config/start.sh (seeded from the repo on first boot — edit it there to change model, context, sessions, or draft depth). No container environment variables are used. [br]Host tuning required: syslinux append amdgpu.gttsize=126976 amdgpu.no_system_mem_limit=1 ttm.pages_limit=32505856 amd_iommu=off, BIOS UMA Frame Buffer Size 512M. [br]This is the ROCm half of the A/B pair: it needs /dev/kfd and only one of this container or deepseek-v4-flash-vulkan can hold the GPU at a time. Stop one before starting the other and give the driver a moment to release GTT. Thinking mode is on by default; allow generous max_tokens in clients.
Container.PostArgs: -c "if [ ! -s /config/start.sh ]; then curl -fsSL -o /config/start.sh.tmp https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iknox/unraid-templates/main/config-examples/qwen38-flash-next-gufo.start.sh && mv /config/start.sh.tmp /config/start.sh || { rm -f /config/start.sh.tmp; echo 'failed to seed /config/start.sh'; exit 1; }; fi; exec bash /config/start.sh"
Container.Description: Strix Halo-only (gfx1151) Gufo server for the UD-Q4_K_XL shards. Host port 9931 maps to the server's 8080. Configure via /config/start.sh on the appdata share — no env vars. Requires the GTT/VRAM host tuning documented in DEPLOY.md.

Config.Name: HTTP / API
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible API and WebUI. Gufo listens on 8080 inside the container; host 9931 is llama.cpp's announced future default.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: GGUF files. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-UD-Q4_K_XL/ (4 shards, mmproj, shared Q8_0 MTP head) is downloaded here automatically on first boot if absent.

Config.Name: Runtime config
Config.Description: Holds start.sh — the gufo serve command line (model, MTP head, context, sessions, draft depth). Seeded automatically on first boot; edit and restart to apply.
